claims.subject: vito

evidence.quote: Inside this temple," Vito continued, "is a door that leads to the resting place of our ancient god and sire, Aclazotz, creator of the first vampires.
If the path to Aclazotz continued through such inhospitable and deadly terrain, Bartolomé wondered whether, despite Vito's assertions, a god as powerful as theirs was meant to be found.

claims.summary: Vito leads a vampire expedition into the Core to find and awaken Aclazotz.

claims.subject: vito

evidence.quote: One by one, the prisoners were delivered unto the bat god, who feasted on their essences as Vito respectfully averted his gaze.

claims.summary: Vito feeds prisoners to Aclazotz to restore him.

evidence.quote: This conditional loyalty is not loathsome to Aclazotz, as he, too, uses his faithful as a means to an end of his own: release from his imprisonment by Ojer Axonil.

claims.subject: ojer_axonil

evidence.quote: Ojer Axonil is the younger, fiery brother of Ojer Taq.

claims.summary: Ojer Axonil is Ojer Taq's younger brother.

claims.subject: ojer_pakpatiq

evidence.quote: Ojer Pakpatiq is the lover of Ojer Taq and second god of the Oltec.

claims.summary: Ojer Pakpatiq is Ojer Taq's lover.

claims.subject: huatli

evidence.quote: The lance slid through the vampire's plate armor, piercing his vile heart and pinning him to the ground.
Huatli stood over him in silence as he fell sideways, blood pooling beneath him on the dark earth.

claims.summary: Huatli kills Vito with his own lance.

claims.subject: vito

evidence.quote: Inti's shield knocked Vito's lance away, his sword slashing down toward Vito's neck.
Vito drove his lance down in a single, powerful thrust—straight into the skull of Inti's mount.
The vampire's death would not return her cousin to life.

claims.summary: Vito duels Inti in the air and kills his mount; Inti is dead by episode 6.
claims.limitation: Clavileño seizes Inti after Vito downs his mount; who struck the killing blow is not graded.

evidence.quote: She mounted her own bat and flew away from the bodies of family and foe, promising Inti that she would return when every vampire in the Core was eradicated.
And yet your title was stolen for you by your cousin Inti rather than granted by the late emperor.

claims.subject: bartolome

evidence.quote: Bartolomé died to protect her and Kellan, but his sacrifice was in vain.

claims.summary: Bartolomé dies protecting Amalia and Kellan.
claims.limitation: Told in Amalia's point of view; 'in vain' is her judgement.

claims.subject: kellan

evidence.quote: I suspect," Bartolomé said, laying a hand on Kellan's shoulder, "that whether you find your father or not, you'll know yourself quite well by the end of your quest.

claims.summary: Kellan's quest is to find his father.
claims.limitation: Oko is not named in this passage; identifying the father as Oko relies on the WOE and OTJ packs.

claims.subject: saheeli

evidence.quote: Saheeli said, whispering, her lips brushing Huatli's.
She threaded one finger through Saheeli's hair, slowly twirling it.

claims.summary: In 'Pawns', Saheeli and Huatli are a couple.

evidence.quote: Soon after Saheeli's arrival and subsequent stranding on Ixalan, Huatli schooled her in the game that gripped this high court.

claims.subject: inti

evidence.quote: She and nineteen of her fellow warriors reported to Inti and Caparocti, Imperial officers sent by the emperor to aid Huatli in her mission.

claims.summary: Inti is one of the Imperial officers sent by the emperor to aid Huatli's expedition.

claims.subject: amalia

evidence.quote: Amalia had misjudged just enough that the man almost fell as well.
"I'm in your debt," he said, bowing politely.
I'll take responsibility for him. We've lost too many—perhaps he can help.

claims.summary: Amalia saves Kellan from a fall and vouches for him to Vito.

claims.subject: kellan

evidence.quote: "Where did you come from?" Bartolomé asked.
"Eldraine," Kellan replied.

claims.summary: Kellan tells the vampire expedition he came from Eldraine.
claims.limitation: He says he came from Eldraine; the passage does not state where he was born.

remaining: Episode 2 is only lightly modelled (Wayta's point of view is not graded)
Malcolm and Breeches' storyline and the Mycotyrant are not graded
The fate of Aclazotz is not graded
